description: The Government intends to negotiate a sole source award with National Law-Enforcement Telecommunications System (NLETS) located at 1918 W. Whispering Wind Dr. in Phoenix, AZ 85085.  NLETS is a ‘501(c) (3) not-for-profit corporation owned and operated by the 50 States, districts and territories known as the principal membership and is administered by a Board of Directors elected from those state law-enforcement agencies.  NLETS is the only vendor capable of satisfying this requirement.  THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS.
